tools.description: Looks up a request by the reference from the submit and the last four digits of the phone on that request. A match says the request was received. A mismatch says it was not found, without saying which part was wrong.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_agency_info" is 1110 chars, far longer than this server's median (215). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agency_info, how_to_get_a_quote, list_pages, get_quote_requirements · Private data: how_to_get_a_quote, preview_callback_request, preview_quote_sheet, submit_quote_sheet, get_claims_and_payment_contacts, preview_appointment, preview_policy_service · Public sink: get_agency_info, how_to_get_a_quote, preview_callback_request, submit_callback_request, get_quote_requirements, get_request_status, submit_quote_sheet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agency_info, how_to_get_a_quote, list_pages, get_quote_requirements · Private data: how_to_get_a_quote, preview_callback_request, preview_quote_sheet, submit_quote_sheet, get_claims_and_payment_contacts, preview_appointment, preview_policy_service · Public sink: get_agency_info, how_to_get_a_quote, preview_callback_request, submit_callback_request, get_quote_requirements, get_request_status, submit_quote_sheet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
